description: This file defines a singleton class `DBService` that manages access to a local SQLite database for an expense tracking application. It handles database schema creation, including creating an `expenses` table with relevant fields, and creates indexes on `date` and `category` columns for efficient querying.

classes.name: DBService
classes.description: A singleton class providing access and management for the local expenses database, including schema creation and migrations.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that returns the initialized database instance, creating and opening the database if necessary.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Internal method that initializes the database, specifying schema creation and indexes.
